task.title: P6-128: Compute leaving after the delete await, not before, to fix mid-delete navigation
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, /my collection page, tree and collection header). Original id: P6-128. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`leaving` is computed before the await, so a navigation *during* a delete still yanks the user to the deleted node's parent** (was `P6-017f`; `tree_manage.rs:533`).
